item.text: {"analysis":"The candidate reached a best observed validation HR@10 of 0.670 at epoch 15, versus the supplied 0.665 baseline (+0.005). However, the run crashed during post-training correctness checking: the frozen host requires positive training scores to equal the raw sequence–item embedding dot product. Learned item biases violate that assertion; zero initialization only preserves equality before biases change. This is a scoring-contract failure, so the observed improvement is not an accepted successful submission. Future candidates must preserve dot-product scoring and modify the encoder or embeddings instead.","code_summary":"Position-free causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional embeddings, eight independent gated local/dilated convolution blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8], kernel size 3, GELU, layer normalization, dropout 0.2, learned per-channel residual scales initialized to 0.1, padding masks, and last-valid-position candidate scoring. The attempted change added zero-initialized per-item scalar biases to positive, negative, and candidate scores. Constants and interfaces were preserved, but additive biases conflicted with the frozen host’s scoring assertion."}
